scientific_integrity: Explicit elementary proof and finite independent enumeration. Infinite-parameter and Poisson statements rest on symbolic proof. No independent validation or claimed absolute priority.
scientific_limitations: Applies to finite k-free algebras of disjoint alternatives and independent uniform random generators. Does not cover pointed undefined-constant expansions or arbitrary sampling schemes. Deterministic generating-rank enumeration follows from older normal form machinery.
title: Two-scale Poisson law for random generation of finite algebras of disjoint alternatives
